scope: Validate PROC-201 (Find Email) process documentation against the executable-process invariant set from US run-003. Evaluate all 10 invariant layers (L1, L5, L8, L9, L10, L12, L13, L14, L15, L24) for structural completeness. The subject is a single process specification — not its runtime behavior or data output.
excluded: slot_workbench data (runtime fill, not process structure)
Other processes (200, 202, 300 — upstream/downstream, not in scope)
intent: Validate PROC-201 against unified template v6.0.0 and Grid Reader requirements — evaluate whether the existing process document conforms to the invariant set discovered by US for the executable-process medium.

invariant_set_summary.name: Executable Process
invariant_set_summary.check: Process document exists at declared CTB position with three cluster headers

invariant_set_summary.name: Process Identity
invariant_set_summary.check: 18 required fields (10 process + 8 HEIR) present and non-empty

invariant_set_summary.name: IMO Declaration
invariant_set_summary.check: Two-Question Intake answered, Middle table with >=1 row (5 columns), Output names downstream consumer

invariant_set_summary.name: Data Schema
invariant_set_summary.check: READ table >=1 row, join chain to spine ID, forbidden paths present

invariant_set_summary.name: Structure Extraction (DMJ)
invariant_set_summary.check: Define table non-empty, Map references all Define IDs, Join path reaches spine

invariant_set_summary.name: Guard Rails
invariant_set_summary.check: >=6 declared stop conditions from canonical set

invariant_set_summary.name: Verification
invariant_set_summary.check: >=1 numbered step with expected result, Three Primitives Check present

invariant_set_summary.name: Measurement
invariant_set_summary.check: Metrics table defined before build, sigma tracking active after 3+ runs, ORBT gate rules present

invariant_set_summary.name: Execution Trace
invariant_set_summary.check: Per-step entry schema with 14 required fields, append-only enforced

invariant_set_summary.name: ORBT Gate Rules
invariant_set_summary.check: Current ORBT state declared, four state transitions defined, auditor != builder enforced

acceptance_criteria: All 10 invariant set comparators evaluated with measurements
P score computed per comparator and overall
DMJ steps evaluated in forced order (Define->Map->Join)
Guard rails include all 6 canonical stop conditions
HEIR identity has all 8 fields populated
ORBT gate rules define all 4 transitions
Execution trace schema declares all 14 fields
Three Primitives Check present in verification section

downstream_instructions.02-define: Evaluate PROCESS.md sections against L19 (Define Step). The subject already has Section 6 (C&V) with comparators and tolerances defined. Check: does every data element have ID, format, description, C-or-V classification?
downstream_instructions.03-map: Evaluate PROCESS.md Section 5 (OSAM) against L20 (Map Step). Check: do READ/WRITE tables map source elements to target structure? Does DATA_FLOW.md provide the mapping?
downstream_instructions.04-join: Evaluate PROCESS.md join chain against L21 (Join Step). Check: does the join chain reach the spine ID (outreach_id)? Is the path documented?
downstream_instructions.05-qc: Compute P score for each invariant set comparator. Evaluate overall P(x;θ) = 1 if max_i[C_i(x)/k_i] <= 1.
downstream_instructions.06-audit: Cannot audit on run 1. Produce receipt noting minimum 3 runs required before certification.
